company.name: USim
company.shortDescription: USim is Kuwait’s leading travel eSIM platform, simplifying roaming for travelers across the GCC.
company.description: USim is Kuwait’s leading eSIM travel platform, now scaling across the GCC. Since its 2024 launch, the app has simplified roaming for hundreds of thousands of travelers through instant digital activation, competitive rates, and localized customer support. By partnering with telcos, fintechs, and travel players, USim is redefining regional connectivity and driving the digital transformation of travel across the Middle East.
